sources.title: Lie Algebras and Cohomology of Congruence Subgroups for SL_n(R)
sources.author: Jonathan Lopez
sources.publication: Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra 218 (2014), 256--268
sources.verified_scope: The p-congruence filtration quotients are identified with traceless matrix data, including n=2 and Gaussian-integer cases in the paper's stated scope.
sources.does_not_support: The signed unoriented jet convention, the exact finite collision certificate, or the combined negative-specificity package.

sources.title: Equivalent Trace Sets for Arithmetic Fuchsian Groups
sources.author: Grant S. Lakeland
sources.publication: Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society 145 (2017), 445--459
sources.verified_scope: Corollary 3.6 derives the level-squared trace form for principal congruence groups, while Theorem 1.3 and Section 5 show that proper finite-index Bianchi subgroups can retain the full complex trace set.
sources.does_not_support: The arbitrary-commutative-ring determinant formula, signed jet, or loxodromic derivative counts.

sources.title: Composition Identities of Chebyshev Polynomials, via 2 x 2 Matrix Powers
sources.verified_scope: The paper treats the standard relationship between traces of powers of nonsingular 2 x 2 matrices and Chebyshev-polynomial matrix-power formulas.
sources.does_not_support: Any independent novelty claim for the manuscript's Cayley--Hamilton recurrence or its arithmetic owner interpretation.
